svg.text: LulzBot TAZ 6 → SmoothieBox exterior connection study
Proposed exterior terminals → dotted function candidates or explicit OPEN boundaries; no installed harness claim

g.title: G01: explicit design-schematic function guess to TAZ/6.03 P/O C-GRID CONN 1 position 13 (X-MAX NC switch SW1; RAMBo X_MAX_IN side). FUNCTION GUESS ONLY, not a direct cable or a fitted conductor. Basis: TAZ/6.03 shows XMAX as a passive NC SW1/SW2 loop; pairing its signal side with the like-named SmoothieBox XMAX input is a function guess, not installed wiring. Interface: Unverified dry-contact input and return; legacy RAMBo net and SmoothieBox input voltage, pull-up, common and fail-safe behavior may differ. Never use SENSOR + for this candidate. Checks: Identify the fitted TAZ revision and confirm this connector/contact with unpowered continuity measurements.; Verify switch NC/open behavior, SmoothieBox input voltage and pull-up, common reference, and fail-safe response before connecting.; Trace and isolate the passive device pair from the legacy RAMBo/controller and other powered circuitry before any retrofit; do not connect two controllers through an existing energized harness.

G02: explicit design-schematic function guess to TAZ/6.03 P/O C-GRID CONN 1 position 14 (X-MAX NC switch SW2; RAMBo GND side). FUNCTION GUESS ONLY, not a direct cable or a fitted conductor. Basis: TAZ/6.03 shows XMAX as a passive NC SW1/SW2 loop; pairing its GND side with the like-named SmoothieBox XMAX input is a function guess, not installed wiring. Interface: Unverified dry-contact input and return; legacy RAMBo net and SmoothieBox input voltage, pull-up, common and fail-safe behavior may differ. Never use SENSOR + for this candidate. svg.text: DOTTED VIOLET = FUNCTION GUESS ONLY. Paths start at the actual drawn exterior screw and end at the named machine contact. No installed continuity or direct cable is established.
FORM INVENTORY ONLY = nominal positions for a named or possible connector form. This does not prove an installed connector, cavity view, function, or electrical route.

OPEN / hollow contact = no SmoothieBox route selected in this study. This does not mean an electrically open circuit, unused pin or NC in the source. Source-empty, unlisted and untranscribed roles remain distinct in their labels.

REFERENCE ONLY = a named source revision, not the installed machine. Reference contacts stay OPEN unless an individually cited dotted function guess is shown. Named hardware with no contact map has an OPEN boundary, not invented '?' pins.

Paths may cross without joining; pale crossing clearance means NO JUNCTION. Multiple guesses from one screw are alternatives unless each shares an explicit FAN-OUT tag. A tagged fan-out still needs separate buffers and load validation. No return bus

Exterior label colors: black = circuit GND; red = 3.3 V; orange = 5 V; yellow/gold = load/control feed; blue/violet/green = STEP/DIR/ENABLE. Dotted violet is an evidence state, not a reported cable color. Protective earth is not circuit GND.

DB25, DB44 and 15-contact D-sub housings are outside SmoothieBox. Contact strips preserve source order, not physical pin-row geometry. USB device, USB host, Ethernet and microSD are separate service ports.
RESEARCH DIAGRAM — NOT QUALIFIED FOR PHYSICAL WIRING. Confirm the actual carrier, machine revision, mating view, electrical interface, protection, returns and safety design before construction.
